title: canopy-page settings.json
description: The one configuration file a canopy-page site reads. Every field is optional — an empty {} builds, with navigation derived from the folder tree.

$schema.description: This file's own URL, so an editor offers completion and inline validation. Read and ignored by canopy-page itself.

title.description: Site name, shown in the top bar and document title. Defaults to the directory name.

description.description: Fills <meta name="description">, which is what link previews show.

lang.description: BCP 47 language tag for <html lang> (e.g. "en", "ko-KR"). Worth setting for any non-English site — it changes only what <html lang> declares; the reader chrome's own text needs `strings` as well.

colorScheme.description: The site's one colour scheme, for a site that has only one: every page is drawn in it whatever the reader's system prefers, and there is no theme toggle. Absent, pages follow the system preference.

icon.description: Favicon, relative to this file. Must be a published file.

styles.description: Stylesheets, relative to this file, linked after canopy's and canopy-page's own CSS in the order given. Those sit in cascade layers, so these win at any specificity. Each must be a published file, linked where it stands, so a relative url() inside it resolves as written.

exclude.description: Paths to leave unpublished, relative to this file: a directory ("_drafts" or "_drafts/**"), an extension at any depth ("*.tmp"), or one exact path.

profile.description: How the site reads by default. "manual": a tree to look things up in. "stream": dated pages, newest first, one column, with an index listing them. Sections can set their own.

pageSize.description: With "profile": "stream", how many posts the front page lists; the rest continue on page/2.html on. Defaults to 10.

regions.description: HTML fragments, relative to this file, that fill the site's regions. header and footer replace canopy's own with the fragment's markup; head, beforeArticle and afterArticle add to the page. canopy's controls go where <canopy-slot name="…"></canopy-slot> elements say.

sections.description: Ordered regions of the site. Without them, navigation follows the folder tree.

logo.description: Image shown beside the site title, relative to this file. Must be a published file.

home.description: A link back to the site this documentation sits beside. Both halves or neither.

url.description: An absolute http(s) URL, or a relative one naming a path from the site's own root (e.g. "../").

label.description: Link text, in the site's own language — canopy-page has no built-in translation table.

siteUrl.description: Where the built site will stand, as an absolute http(s) URL. Only when set does `build` write sitemap.xml, a robots.txt pointing at it, and the <head> tags a search engine reads as addresses (canonical, og:url, og:image, hreflang).

previewImage.description: Image link previews show (og:image) for any page whose frontmatter has no `image` of its own, relative to this file. Must be a published file. Needs siteUrl.

alternates.description: The site's other language editions: hreflang tag (or "x-default") → that edition's own absolute site URL. Each page then names its counterpart at the same path under every edition, in <head> and in sitemap.xml. Needs siteUrl.

rehypePlugins.description: Installed rehype plugin package names to run on every page, after canopy's sanitize step and before syntax highlighting.

knownBroken.description: Pages known to have broken links or images, published anyway while they are fixed: their broken references are warnings naming the reason instead of errors. An entry with nothing left to excuse is flagged for removal.

path.description: A page, "dir/*" for the pages directly in a directory, or "dir/**" for every page beneath it.

reason.description: Why these pages are let through.

strings.description: Overrides for the reader chrome's own text. `lang` alone does not translate it, since it is canopy's UI (or canopy-page's own search script), not vault content. Keys left out keep their English default.

indexTitle.description: Title and heading of the auto-generated contents page at the site root. Default: "Contents"

backlinks.description: Heading over a page's list of pages that link to it. Default: "Linked references"

breadcrumb.description: Accessible label for the topbar's ancestor-trail nav. Default: "Breadcrumb"

language.description: Accessible label for the other-language links a language slot shows. Defaults to "Languages".

readingTime.description: A stream page's reading time, with {n} where the minutes go. Defaults to "{n} min read".

skipToContent.description: The link every page opens with for keyboard readers, past the header and navigation to the content. Defaults to "Skip to content".

newerPost.description: Over the link at a stream post's end to the post published after it. Defaults to "Newer post".

olderPost.description: Over the link at a stream post's end to the post published before it. Defaults to "Older post".

pageOf.description: Where a page of a stream's list is, with {n} for its number and {total} for how many there are. Defaults to "Page {n} of {total}".

newerPosts.description: The link to the page of a stream's list before this one, with newer posts. Defaults to "Newer posts".

olderPosts.description: The link to the page of a stream's list after this one, with older posts. Defaults to "Older posts".

tags.description: A stream post's tags' label, and the title of a stream's list of tags. Defaults to "Tags".

searchFailed.description: Message shown when the client search index fails to load. Default: "Search failed to load."

section.description: One ordered region of the site: a guide, a release log, a reference section.

path.description: Directory this section covers, relative to this file.

label.description: Heading shown for the section. Defaults to the directory name.

order.description: Order for the pages inside, when they are not listed one by one. "desc" is what a release log wants: newest first.

items.description: Explicit contents, in display order. Overrides `order`.

feed.description: Publish an Atom feed of the section's dated pages (those whose frontmatter names a `date:`) at <path>/feed.xml, linked from the section's pages. Needs siteUrl. A stream section has one by default once siteUrl is set; false turns it off.

profile.description: How this section reads; defaults to the site's profile. A stream section takes no order or items: it is ordered newest first by its pages' date:.

pageSize.description: With this section's own "profile": "stream", how many posts its index lists; the rest continue on <path>/page/2.html on. Defaults to 10.

regions.description: Fragments for this section, over the site's regions key by key. "" turns one off here.

navItem.description: One entry in a section's contents: a page (a bare string is shorthand for { path }), or a group of entries.

label.description: Display text. Defaults to the page's title, then its filename.

path.description: Path of the page, relative to this file, with or without .md.
